assumptions: Limit line is assumed marked at this site so only the 'if marked' branch is checked; crosswalk and entrance-to-roadway alternatives are out of scope and have no geometry.
All tracked vehicles in the approach are assumed subject as approaching a stop sign; sign presence is not detectable.
'Stop' is interpreted as remaining effectively stationary continuously for at least 1000 ms inside stop_zone; statute states no duration.
Stopping 'at' the limit line is interpreted as stopping anywhere inside stop_zone, the last 10 m before the line.
Only inbound crossings from y<0.6 to y>0.6, encoded as to_right, trigger the requirement; vehicles that never cross pass vacuously.
raw_output.normalized_explanation: Every vehicle that crosses the stop line inbound must have first stopped stationary inside the approach waiting zone.

provenance.reason: Top-down boxes: centre is metric position; bottom_center is downstream AABB edge, not ground contact, so centre is correct point.

provenance.quote: shall stop at a limit line, if marked

provenance.reason: Statute states only 'approaching'; inbound (+y, y<0.6 to y>0.6) is encoded as to_right per line definition.
Statute says only 'at a limit line'; stop_zone (last 10 m before line) used as proxy area for stopping at the line.
Statute gives no minimum stop duration; 1000 ms assumed as minimum continuous stopped time to register a stop.
Statute gives no time window between stop and crossing; any prior stop before crossing accepted.

text:
The driver of any vehicle approaching a stop sign at the entrance to, or within, an intersection shall stop at a limit line, if marked, otherwise before entering the crosswalk on the near side of the intersection.

If there is no limit line or crosswalk, the driver shall stop at the entrance to the intersecting roadway.
